Elementi lineari, puntuali ed areali della rete ferroviaria e ferrotramviaria della Provincia di Firenze. Strati informativi dell'art. 31 del Piano Territoriale di Coordinamento Provinciale approvato con Delib. C.P. del 10/01/2013 (BURT n. 11 del 13/03/2013). Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are art-31, citta-metropolitana-firenze, ferrovia, governo-e-settore-pubblico, ptcp-2013. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
